findings.summary: The previous-attempt upstream finding (body-less POST without Content-Type -> 415) is already fixed in the current httpClient: every POST/PUT/PATCH sends Content-Type application/json and a `{}` body when none is given. No edit made here (file outside this unit). exportBackup() relies on this.

AC-dm-37 end-to-end (export -> import round trip and refusal with role=alert) was not exercised: server/routes/backupRoutes.ts (phase 4-backend-backup, wave 10) and tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts (4-integration-e2e-features) do not exist yet. Only the local Done when (pnpm build) decides this unit.

messages.text: src/api/backupApi.ts consumes IF-009 as: POST /api/backup/export (no body; client sends `{}` with Content-Type application/json) -> { fileName, directory, companies: number, diagnoses: number }. POST /api/backup/import with the parsed file JSON as the body -> { imported: { companies, diagnoses }, skipped: { companies, diagnoses } } — ASSUMPTION: `skipped` is an object with the same two counts (IF-009 leaves its shape open); please match it or report back. Errors: 422 backup_invalid; 422 backup_newer_version with `rulesVersion` as an extra key of `error` (number, e.g. 2); 413 for >10 MB. The UI shows error.message when present, so the server message for backup_newer_version should be the F-06 text 'O arquivo veio de uma versão mais nova do app (regras vN). Atualize o FitPulse pela loja do Play e tente de novo. Nenhum dado foi alterado.'

Selectors for tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts: section [data-aioson-id=settings-backup]; buttons [data-aioson-id=backup-export] 'Exportar meus dados' and [data-aioson-id=backup-import] 'Importar uma cópia'; hidden file input [data-aioson-id=backup-import-file] (use setInputFiles, accept .json). Results are role="alert" with data-state success|error: backup-export-saved ('Cópia salva'), backup-export-error, backup-import-done ('Cópia importada'), backup-import-error ('Não foi possível importar {arquivo}' + 'Escolher outro arquivo'). Non-JSON and >10 MB files are refused client-side without calling the server. Run after 4-backend-backup: pnpm test -- tests/api/backupRoutes.test.ts and pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts.
